text: The Company expects that Cost of Goods Sold will be 60% of total sales for each month. It costs the company $6 to purchase the inventory they sell for $10. Remember: Cost of Good Sold means inventory sold in that month The Company knows it is important to purchase more inventory than just what is needed for the current month so they have a requirement to have extra inventory on hand equal to 30% of next month’s projected cost of goods sold. Questions: How much inventory needs to be purchased for each month? What will COGS be for the 15t quarter? What will be left in inventory as of 3/31/247?
